claims.claim: Hesychius of Jerusalem was a presbyter (priest) of the Church of Jerusalem in the early fifth century, probably born in the late fourth century and died after 450.
He served as a priest in Jerusalem from about 412 and was renowned as a biblical commentator and preacher.
Hesychius composed a pair of homilies on the feast of Hypapante (the Presentation of Jesus in the Temple).
The homilies were delivered on the feast celebrated on 14 February at the Martyrion (Golgotha) in Jerusalem.
